text:
Sam_marketing: Quick sync  launching a micro-pricing calculator for the EU webinar. Need: micro-FAQ, CTA A/B, default tokens, and routing rules. Low lift.
Asha_content: I can draft 2-line FAQ answers and the benchmark qualifier. Will aim for EU-friendly phrasing.
Tom_growth: I'll run the A/B: CTA A = "Estimate my monthly cost"; CTA B = "Show my monthly price". Track clicks -> signup -> MQL and utm_variant.
Rina_ops: For routing: utm_region=EU -> EU-SDR. If estimated_monthly_cost >= 750 -> escalate to AE_EU. Ill add utm_campaign=eu_mini_calc, utm_variant=A|B.
Asha_content: Draft FAQ: Q: How are overages billed? A: Monthly at your plan rate; we notify at 80% usage. Q: Can I get dedicated capacity? A: Yes  contact sales to enable. Q: How do you handle EU data? A: Logs stored in EU regions, GDPR controls available. Also adding: "Typical savings on common text workloads; results vary by model and prompt."
Legal_bot: Flag: any public savings language must be hedged (you already did). Send final copy for 24h review before deploy.
Tom_growth: Experiment defaults: Variant A default tokens=25k, Variant B default=50k. Segment returning users separately.
Sam_marketing: Small low-risk tweak: swap tier labels CSS-only: "Build / Grow / Enterprise" vs "Launch / Scale / Enterprise". Add as secondary test.
Rina_ops: Ops timeline: wire UTMs Mon, Optimizely config Mon afternoon, deploy Tue AM. I'll annotate SFDC with utm_variant.
Sam_marketing: Great. Asha drop copy here by EOD and I'll kick off Optimizely. Thanks everyone :rocket:
